display.name: High-Yield Aggressive
display.description:
Maximum-velocity mandate with a deliberately thin manager contribution - seed capital sits just above the protocol minimum, so depositor principal is the dominant share of the book. This is the high end of the risk stack and is priced accordingly.

Exit threshold is set low (0.60x): the vault must be substantially underwater before an exit can be forced, giving the manager maximum latitude to trade through drawdowns without depositors unwinding the book mid-trade. Withdrawal limits are correspondingly tight. Depositors here are underwriting manager skill with limited structural protection - the trade-off for the headline yield.
display._x_note: X linking needs a real OAuth click-through per vault (getXChallenge -> authorize on X -> setVaultXConnection). Not automatable; see README.
